mapper.sql: control_profile_id AS controlProfileId, name, description, control_kind AS controlKind, movement_lock_mode AS movementLockMode, cast_lock_mode AS castLockMode, attack_lock_mode AS attackLockMode, input_override_mode AS inputOverrideMode, displacement_kind AS displacementKind, blocks_control_input AS blocksControlInput, grants_unstoppable AS grantsUnstoppable, breaks_on_damage AS breaksOnDamage, tenacity_reducible AS tenacityReducible, priority, extend::text AS extendJson
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.control_state_profiles WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY control_profile_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.control_state_profiles (game_id, control_profile_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, name, description, control_kind, movement_lock_mode, cast_lock_mode, attack_lock_mode, input_override_mode, displacement_kind, blocks_control_input, grants_unstoppable, breaks_on_damage, tenacity_reducible, priority, extend, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{controlProfileId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{controlKind}, #{movementLockMode}, #{castLockMode}, #{attackLockMode}, #{inputOverrideMode}, #{displacementKind}, #{blocksControlInput}, #{grantsUnstoppable}, #{breaksOnDamage}, #{tenacityReducible}, #{priority}, COALESCE(CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, control_profile_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, control_kind = EXCLUDED.control_kind, movement_lock_mode = EXCLUDED.movement_lock_mode, cast_lock_mode = EXCLUDED.cast_lock_mode, attack_lock_mode = EXCLUDED.attack_lock_mode, input_override_mode = EXCLUDED.input_override_mode, displacement_kind = EXCLUDED.displacement_kind, blocks_control_input = EXCLUDED.blocks_control_input, grants_unstoppable = EXCLUDED.grants_unstoppable, breaks_on_damage = EXCLUDED.breaks_on_damage, tenacity_reducible = EXCLUDED.tenacity_reducible, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, updated_at = NOW()
